description: Free; reads only. Finds the TollNode tools for a task and returns each match's name, title, one-line purpose, category and price per call, best matches first. Use it first whenever you need a capability (make an image or video, a voice or song, read a web page, search Google or Maps, get LinkedIn, YouTube, Amazon or other platform data, check a domain, weather or public data). Then call get_tool with the name you pick, then run_tool. With no query it lists everything in the category, or the whole catalog.

category.description: Only this category, e.g. Image, Video, Audio, Search, Social, Shopping, Business, Travel, Lookup, Document.

limit.description: Most results to return, 1 to 50. Default 20

query.description: The task, model or platform in plain words, e.g. 'remove background', 'video with sound', 'linkedin company', 'gpt image'. Leave out to list all.

name: search_tools
title: Search TollNode tools
